name: Sylas
summary: Sylas features a silver mirror with crisp, luminous clarity, set against a matte white back panel that heightens the overall brightness and refinement. Brushed bronze plated metal accents add a warm, elegant richness, giving the piece a polished, high end presence. 5mm silver mirror, the back panel in matte white paint, metal parts plated brushed bronze. 120×3.7(4.4)
